entries.note: `Switch` forwards `size` to `Toggle`. Modern resolves the Ant spelling (`small` -> sm, `middle`/`default` -> md, `large` -> lg). Classic and Rustic look the raw value up in step tables keyed `xs|sm|md|lg|xl`: every Ant spelling missed and rendered the `md` fallback. So `middle` -> `md` and `default` -> `md` render the same step on all three engines (only the unstyled root class token `rottay-toggle--<size>` changes on Classic and Rustic), while `small` -> `sm` and `large` -> `lg` change the rendered step on Classic and Rustic
